abstract: Forty-one cases of embryonal carcinoma were analyzed from a clinico-pathological point of view. The clinical stages of the patients were: 21 cases in stage I, 8 in stage II, 11 in stage III and 1 in stage IV. Survival curves were compared in accordance with clinical stages. A statistically significant difference was demonstrated between stages I and III, and a significant difference was demonstrated between stages I and II. Embryonal carcinoma in a narrow sense and yolk sac carcinoma were compared in survival curve but there were no significant differences between the two. Cases were divided into two that were pure embryonal carcinoma and embryonal carcinoma with other constituent mixtures. A comparison of these two showed that the mixed type had a better survival curve than the pure type. Effects of treatment in two different periods were compared patients who were treated in 1971-1979 belong to the 1st period group and those treated in 1979-1985 to the 2nd period group. A comparison of these two showed a much better survival curve in the 2nd period group. This difference can be attributed partly to a VAC combination chemotherapy and its maintenance for two years and partly to improvements in the operating technique such as added omentectomy and or the introduction of a second look operation. By measuring alpha FP over the whole clinical course, alpha FP was shown to be a good tumor marker reflecting the patient's condition and aggravation of the patient's condition frequently occurred around or somewhat after 15 weeks after primary surgery.
abstract_ja: 卵巣胎児性癌41例について、臨床病理学的観点から解析した。臨床病期は、病期Iが21例、病期IIが8例、病期IIIが11例、病期IVが1例であった。生存曲線を臨床病期別に比較したところ、病期Iと病期IIIの間、および病期Iと病期IIの間で統計学的に有意差が認められた。狭義の胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍について生存曲線を比較したが、両者の間に有意差はなかった。症例は純粋な胎児性癌と、他の構成成分を伴う混合型の2群に分類した。両者を比較すると、混合型の方が純粋型よりも生存曲線が良好であった。治療効果を2つの期間で比較した。1971～1979年に治療された患者を第1期群、1979～1985年に治療された患者を第2期群とした。両群を比較すると、第2期群で生存曲線が著しく良好であった。この差は、VAC併用化学療法とその2年間の維持療法、および大網切除の追加やセカンドルック手術の導入などの手術手技の改善によるものと考えられる。治療経過を通じてαフェトプロテイン(AFP)を測定したところ、AFPは患者の状態を反映する良好な腫瘍マーカーであることが示された。また、病状の悪化は原発手術後15週前後またはその後にしばしば認められた。
